name: lilypond-studio
description: Language support and preview for LilyPond, a music engraving system

lilypondStudio.executablePath.description: Path to the LilyPond executable. If not in PATH, provide the full path (e.g., C:\Program Files (x86)\LilyPond\usr\bin\lilypond.exe). Default: 'lilypond'.

lilypondStudio.includeDirs.description: Additional include directories for LilyPond. Each gets appended to the search paths when you use \include in a file. On Windows, ensure you include the trailing slash.

lilypondStudio.commandOptions.markdownDescription: Further command-line options passed to LilyPond, after the ones the build task generates and before the filename (e.g. `-dpaper-size=a3`). `${workspaceFolder}` and `${fileDirname}` are substituted. Individual tasks in `tasks.json` can override this with their own `commandOptions`.

lilypondStudio.languageServerPath.description: Path to the ly-lsp language server executable. Leave empty to use the binary bundled with the extension. Set this to point at a locally-built server (e.g. ../ly-lsp/target/release/ly-lsp.exe) during development.

lilypondStudio.outputDirectory.markdownDescription: Directory LilyPond writes engraved output to, passed as `--output`. Relative paths are resolved against the directory containing the `.ly` file, and `${workspaceFolder}` and `${fileDirname}` are substituted. The directory is created if it does not exist. Leave empty to write the PDF alongside the source file. Individual tasks in `tasks.json` can override this with their own `outputDirectory`.

lilypondStudio.engraveOnSave.description: Automatically re-engrave a LilyPond file whenever it is saved, using the most recent engrave mode (preview or publish).

mode.description: Build mode: preview (with point-and-click) or publish (without point-and-click)

outputDirectory.description: Directory to write output to, passed to lilypond as --output. Relative paths are resolved against the directory containing the .ly file; ${workspaceFolder} and ${fileDirname} are substituted. Created if it does not exist. Overrides the lilypondStudio.outputDirectory setting.

includeDirs.description: Directories to search for \include, each passed to lilypond as --include. Overrides the lilypondStudio.includeDirs setting.

commandOptions.description: Further command-line options passed to lilypond, after the ones the task generates and before the filename. Overrides the lilypondStudio.commandOptions setting.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile
